title: 016 进城！你被人卖了-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    晏梨一行人抵达海底之城门口的时候，东方恰好跃出朝霞，头顶的海水一下子成了洒了金箔的粉红色。

    近在咫尺的黑色巨塔格外的巍峨，几乎每隔二十米便有一座，连着深蓝色的围墙，绕着整个城池。

    在那塔的顶端，有一个八角的滚盘，不停的旋转着，绿色的光线时隐时现一闪而过。

    虽然时间尚早，但城门口已经开始有人进进出出，有一种演默剧的热闹。

    晏梨悄悄地观察着，不一会儿的功夫，她就瞧见了满嘴鲨鱼牙的小姑娘、四肢变成了青蛙腿的老大爷。

    还有一个长满的海带的脑袋，没有身体，只有头，比王学灵还少了三分之二。

    最好看的要属一条人鱼，他的尾巴是浅金色的，流光溢彩，就是不能抬头看，抬头就会看见那满脸的络腮胡，还有一拳能砸出一个巨坑的毛乎乎的铁拳。

    晏梨正看着，就瞧见一团粉红色走了过来，那人还是个人，就是皮肤上布满了福寿螺的卵。

    密密麻麻的，让人看得汗毛直立。

    福寿螺卵人走得东倒西歪，眼见着就要撞过来。

    “孙启，你想生孩子想疯了吧，又想欺负新来的！”

    说话间，一个穿着制服的四十左右的大姐走了过来，她看上去格外的和蔼可亲，左手整个变成了一株珊瑚。

    因为说话不能大声，她的怒斥全是气音。

    她说着，白了福寿螺卵人一眼，又看了看晏梨几人的手腕，说道，“新来的不要挨着他，谁挨着他谁怀孕。滚犊子，别在这里影响老娘干活。我姓蔡，叫我蔡大姐就行。”

    蔡大姐从自己的帆布袋里掏出了四个手环，递了过来，“这是分贝仪，绿灯无事，黄灯预警，红灯抹杀，切记。跟我来窗口，登记一下你们的姓名，然后展示你们的变异部位拍张照。”

    晏梨一步上前，试着学了学蔡大姐的气音，“晏梨。”

    她若有所思的动了动背后的翅膀，退了一边，宋子涵等人有样学样，也戴上了分贝仪，尽量小声的说话。

    大肚腩过来的时候，蔡大姐仔细的看了看他，“你是鲶鱼吧，以前我吃烤鱼的时候就喜欢点鲶鱼。你爱人还在不，要是不在我可以给你介绍一个，她的身体变成了鲶鱼，脑袋还是好的。

    你们两个凑在一块儿，鱼也是鱼，人也是人，正好凑个整。”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

When Yan Li and his party arrived at the gate of the Undersea City, the morning glow appeared in the east, and the water above their heads suddenly turned pink with gold foil sprinkled on it.

The huge black towers so close at hand are extremely majestic. There are one almost every 20 meters, connected with dark blue walls, surrounding the entire city.

At the top of the tower, there is an octagonal roller disk that is constantly rotating, with green light flashing in and out.

Although it was still early, people were already starting to come and go at the city gate, and there was a lively atmosphere like a mime.

Yan Li observed quietly, and after a while, she saw the little girl with a mouth full of shark teeth and the old man whose limbs turned into frog legs.

There is also a head covered with kelp. It has no body, only a head, which is two-thirds smaller than Wang Xueling.

The most beautiful one is a mermaid. His tail is light golden and full of brilliance. But you can't look up. If you look up, you will see the full beard on his face and the hairy iron fist that can smash a huge crater with one punch.

Yan Li was watching when she saw a pink mass walking over. The person was still a human being, but his skin was covered with snail eggs.

It’s so densely packed that it makes one’s hair stand on end.

The Fushou Snail Egg Man was walking staggeringly, and he was about to collide with him.

"Sun Qi, you are crazy about having a baby, and you want to bully the new kid!"

While talking, a eldest lady in uniform, about forty years old, came over. She looked particularly amiable, and her left hand turned into a coral.

Because she couldn’t speak loudly, her anger was all breathy.

As she spoke, she rolled her eyes at the lucky snail egg man, then looked at the wrists of Yan Li and others, and said, "Don't touch the new guy, whoever touches him will get pregnant. Go away, don't interfere with my work here. My surname is Cai, just call me Sister Cai."

Sister Cai took out four bracelets from her canvas bag and handed them over, "This is a decibel meter. The green light is okay, the yellow light is warning, and the red light is kill. Remember. Come to the window with me, register your name, and then show your mutated parts and take a photo."

Yan Li stepped forward and tried to imitate Sister Cai's voice, "Yan Li."

She moved the wings on her back thoughtfully and stepped aside. Song Zihan and others followed suit and also put on decibel meters and spoke as quietly as possible.

When the potbelly came over, Sister Cai looked at him carefully and said, "Are you a catfish? I used to like catfish when I ate grilled fish. Is your lover still there? If not, I can introduce you to one. Her body has turned into a catfish, but her head is still good.

“You two get together, fish are also fish, people are also people, just make it together."
